Welding is a widely used area in the industry, showing itself as an effective and low-cost solution when permanently joining two metal parts, being used to manufacture and repair tanks to pipelines. One of the problems presented during the process is caused by the dimensional changes produced by the technique, causing deformation in the piece and cracking in the weld bead due to the concentration of efforts in the area, which ends up affecting the final piece reducing its reliability, these changes are known as distortions. Within the spectrum of existing distortions, the angular distortion for the study to be carried out is chosen, since it is within the most commonly presented distortions, we will begin by investigating the subject by consulting the existing bibliography, and then defining the type of union to analyze depending on the possibilities offered by the experimental method using arc welding as a resource. To compare the experimental results, a numerical model will be generated using a FEM software. Once the data from both tests have been obtained, the results will be concluded.
